evidence.frequency_or_severity: Deploying an unverified, mutable, or unrecoverable candidate can cause production incidents and data loss.

job: Deploy one release-ready immutable candidate through the repository's normal path, observe health, and stop or recover on declared failure signals.

rejected_alternatives: Deployment commands and environments are repository-specific and must not be hard-coded generically.
Deployment side effects must not be an implicit branch of the ship skill.

positive_triggers: Explicit request to deploy a release-ready candidate.
Explicit rollout, release exposure, or production-verification request.
negative_triggers: A candidate without rollback, stop, and health evidence.
inputs: Release-ready evidence and immutable candidate identity.
Canonical deployment path, health signals, stop conditions, and recovery procedure.
outputs: Completed, stopped, rolled-back, or forward-repair-required status.
default: Perform preflight only until explicit target and mutation authority are confirmed.
forbidden_effects: Deploy an unreviewed or mutable candidate.
Claim success before production health is observed.
completion_checks: Declared health signals are acceptable for the observation window.
Recovery status and remaining risks are reported.
